Special City Council Meeting
AGENDA
A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California 90631
4:00 p.m. Closed Session AMENDED
5:00 p.m. Planning Alternate Interviews
06:00 p.m.
April 14, 2015
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1225 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS - SPECIAL MEETING
Each member of the public may speak for three minutes on any action item listed on the agenda except with regard to items listed as public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speaker's card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak.
During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speaker's card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Mayor. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Mayor may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Council.
NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Gov. Code 65009(b)(2).)
I, Roy Francis, as Mayor of the City of La Habra Heights, do hereby call a special meeting of the City Council of the City of La Habra Heights, to be held at the time and place listed above to discuss the matters listed below.
_______________________________________________________
Roy Francis, Mayor of the City of La Habra Heights

APPOINT FIRE MARSHAL - SEASONAL POSITION
RECOMMENDATION: Approve the appointment of a Fire Marshal on a part-time seasonal basis; authorize the transfer of $8,000 from account 260-710FIR-6340 (training) to account 260-710FIR-6120 (wages part time); and direct that the FY 15-16 portion of this position be worked into the upcoming budget.
Staff Report
13.
ACCEPT DONATED FUNDS FOR FIRE DEPARTMENT
RECOMMENDATION: Accept Council Member Roy Francis' donation; increase the Fire Department Budget line item 260-710FIR-6340 by $300 and direct staff to file Form 801 with the Fair Political Practices Commission once the funds have been spent.
Staff Report
14.
COUNTYWIDE HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS AND ELECTRONIC WASTE COLLECTION PROGRAM SITING LIABILITY AGREEMENT
RECOMMENDATION: Authorize the Assistant City Manager, Gabriella Yap, to approve and sign the agreement with Los Angeles County and County Sanitation District 2 to sponsor a Household Hazardous and Electronic Waste Collection Event on July 11, 2015.
Staff Report
15.
ENGAGE CIVIL SOURCE TO PREPARE PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR 2015 ROADS PROJECTS - AUTHORIZE ADVERTISING FOR BIDS
RECOMMENDATION: Authorize the expenditure of up to $20,500 from applicable transportation funds to engage Civil Source to prepare plans and specifications and authorize staff to go out to bid on the 2015 roads projects. -------------------------------- END OF CONSENT CALENDAR --------------------------------
Staff Report

16.
APPOINT ALTERNATE MEMBER TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION
RECOMMENDATION: Appoint ____________________ as an alternate member of the Planning Commission; require the appointee to file a Form 700 with the City Clerk within thirty days of appointment, and to keep all required FPPC filings current as a condition of retaining the position.
Staff Report
17.
INITIATE ORDINANCE - SHORT TERM RENTAL
RECOMMENDATION: Direct staff to draft an Ordinance regulating short term rentals based on the parameters discussed at this meeting; said Ordinance is to be reviewed by the City Attorney and then brought back to Council for review. (Note: If the Ordinance involves changes to Article 7, it will require Planning Commission review).
Staff Report
18.
CONSOLIDATION OF MARCH GENERAL ELECTIONS WITH NOVEMBER ODD YEAR ELECTIONS CONDUCTED BY COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
RECOMMENDATION: Direct the City Manager to contact the County of Los Angeles for consolidation with the County November odd numbered year ballot and if the County agrees, direct the City Manager return to the Council with the necessary changes to the Municipal Code to move election days from March to November in odd-numbered years and Council reorganization dates from March/April to December or January.
Staff Report
19.
AUTHORIZE EMERGENCY PURCHASING PROCESS FOR AIR CONDITIONING IN THE MULTI-PURPOSE ROOM
RECOMMENDATION: Support the City Manager's conclusion that exigent circumstances require the immediate purchase of an air conditioning system for the Multi-Purpose Room; authorize the expenditure of funds for air conditioning the Multi-Purpose Room in an amount to be determined, but not to exceed $45,000 and authorize the transfer of the funds from the General Fund balance to the Facilities Maintenance Budget.
Staff Report
20.
DEMOLISH EQUIPMENT AND REMOVE DUCTING - PREPARATION FOR AIR CONDITIONING THE MULTI-PURPOSE ROOM
RECOMMENDATION: Support the City Manager's conclusion that exigent circumstances require the immediate expenditure of an amount not to exceed $15,000 to hire contractors to abate equipment and ducting associated with heating the multipurpose room, and authorize the transfer of the funds from the General Fund balance to the Facilities Maintenance Budget.
Staff Report
